cover: Questions to ask any software quote

slides.title: What exactly is included?
slides.body: The quote should list the screens, user roles, integrations and data it covers. “Booking system” alone gets argued over later.

slides.title: How are changes priced and approved?
slides.body: A pricey change process can make a fixed quote cost more than paying by the hour would have.

slides.title: What does “done” mean?
slides.body: Look for testing, deployment, a handover and support after launch. Some quotes stop at “code delivered”.

slides.title: Who owns the result?
slides.body: The repository, hosting accounts and domain should be in your name. That's what lets you take the work elsewhere.

slides.title: How will you see progress?
slides.body: Hourly: what does the weekly report show? Fixed price: when will you see working software? A fixed-price project can still run late.

slides.title: What's the price built on?
slides.body: Ask both developers to price the same first phase and list their assumptions and exclusions. Compare those, not just the totals.
